comments: Review: root recovery and walking poses remain proposals. Use delivered cracks, never legacy socket overlays on this design.
Only existing states are wired. All source rectangles and SHA-256 are retained.
Registration correction: centre each complete crop horizontally and keep one shared actor scale/feet baseline; alpha-foot averages were biased by extended boots, splashes and detached specks.
geometry: Ball::circle(80×Q,27×Q,19×Q) is Keeper contact radius including ball; do not derive body collision from shell. Root and crown geometry belong to separate slots.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheet and measured components, 2026-10-15; supplemental poses retained separately.

pieces.label: Idle: planted stance, leaf crown upright, amber visor and split mouth visible.
pieces.name: idle

pieces.label: Root windup: crouched clamp pose with root hands gathered forward.
pieces.name: root-tell

pieces.label: Root attack: thrusts both root arms toward the viewer in a broad clamp.
pieces.name: root-attack

pieces.label: Root recovery: returns to a lower, forward-leaning stance.
pieces.name: proposal-03

pieces.label: Crown windup: folds the leafy crown and compresses low.
pieces.name: crown-tell

pieces.label: Crown attack: braces with antlers spread and root fists raised.
pieces.name: crown-attack

pieces.label: Walk/step 1: steps forward with one root foot lifted.
pieces.name: proposal-06

pieces.label: Walk/step 2: follows through with the opposite foot lifted.
pieces.name: proposal-07

pieces.label: Hit flinch: recoils with arms thrown outward.
pieces.name: flinch

pieces.label: Damage stage 1: first visible shell cracks; visor and lights remain readable.
pieces.name: damage-1

pieces.label: Damage stage 2: further shell cracks and drooped foliage while still active.
pieces.name: damage-2

pieces.label: Defeat: folded low with crown and arms slumped; visor remains dimly visible.
pieces.name: defeat

size_basis: 48×48 at (OX+field_x(80)-24+shake,OY-3)=(190+shake,43); source pivot convention (24,48). Signature sockets in native.json states[].
timing: Nine poses; starts Idle=120. Tell 36 ticks at hp>2, 30 at hp<=2; action 12; subsequent Idle=90+10×hp. Flinch=12, hit cooldown=10; damage stages hp 6–5/4–3/2–1. Defeat at hp=0 (Ball::step; draw()).
